# Base64

Encode and decode standard or URL-safe Base64.

Category: Encoders · ID: `base64` · Search terms: b64, base64url, encode, decode

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui base64 [encode|decode] [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Input

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--mode` | `encode`, `decode` | `encode` | Mode. |
| `--variant` | `standard`, `url` | `standard` | Alphabet. |
| `--padding` | on/off | `true` | Padding. Add '=' when encoding |
| `--output` | `auto`, `text`, `hex` | `auto` | Output. When decoding: auto shows hex if the result is binary |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/base64`), so they are what the tool prints.

### decode-binary

Input:

```text
iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==
```

Output:

```text
89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d49484452000000010000000108060000001f15c4890000000d4944415478da6364f8cf500f00038601805a347d6b0000000049454e44ae426082
```
